title: README
universal_lens: The system unifies multi-view spatial geometry and temporal stochastic filtering. It maps discrete 2D pixel observations into a continuous 3D kinematic state space using Direct Linear Transformation (DLT), while employing adaptive covariance matrices to dynamically balance constant-velocity motion priors against noisy, confidence-weighted visual measurements.
gsi_mapping: GSI utilizes the Kalman measurement noise parameter R as a conformal score for keypoint detections. Bayesian inference updates the posterior skeletal pose by fusing YOLO-pose likelihoods with prior velocity distributions, outputting a rigorous shadow ledger containing exact joint covariances for downstream probabilistic biomechanical modeling.
gse_mapping: GSE treats the athlete's skeleton as a high-dimensional Markovian state-transition system. The process noise Q acts as an action-dependent diffusion term, allowing the engine to predict future kinematic states under sudden accelerations or occlusions, maintaining persistent ByteTrack IDs across complex multi-agent interactions.

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Q: Process noise covariance matrix (dimensionless scaling factor), R: Measurement noise covariance matrix (pixels^2), dt: Time step between frames (seconds).
primitives.assumptions: Keypoint motion follows a linear constant-velocity dynamic model between discrete frames; measurement errors are Gaussian and scale inversely with detector confidence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violent non-linear accelerations exceeding the maximum tuned Q threshold, or prolonged total occlusion causing covariance divergence.

primitives.name: Multi-View DLT Triangulation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Multi-view Call `triangulate_pair(pts1, pts2, P1, P2)` with calibrated 3x4 projection matrices.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: pts1, pts2: 2D homogeneous pixel coordinates (pixels), P1, P2: 3x4 camera projection matrices (metric calibration units), X: 3D world coordinate (meters).
primitives.assumptions: Cameras are perfectly calibrated with known intrinsic and extrinsic parameters; epipolar geometry holds strictly across views.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Near-zero baseline between cameras (degenerate triangulation) or severe perspective ambiguity resulting in ill-conditioned linear systems.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the GSE spatial reconstruction layer, converting disparate 2D observational manifolds into a unified 3D metric tensor field.
layer2.telemetry: Reprojection error magnitude across all synchronized camera feeds post-triangulation.

reasoning_traces.think:
The SkeleTrack proxy constructs a robust kinematic state estimator by marrying computer vision heuristics with classical control theory. At its core, the system relies on a per-keypoint constant-velocity Kalman filter. This implies a state vector $X_t = [p_x, p_y, v_x, v_y]^T$ evolving via a linear transition matrix dependent on the frame delta time $dt$. The mathematical elegance lies in the adaptive nature of the noise covariances. Rather than treating all visual inputs equally, the operator scales the measurement noise $R$ based on the underlying YOLO-pose confidence scores. High-confidence detections yield low $R$, forcing the filter to trust the observation; low-confidence detections increase $R$, causing the filter to rely heavily on the predictive constant-velocity prior. Furthermore, the introduction of joint-specific process noise $Q$ introduces a biomechanical prior into the linear algebra. Extremities (hands, feet) are permitted higher acceleration variances compared to the rigid torso. When multiple cameras are employed, the 2D filtered tracks are elevated to 3D space via Direct Linear Transformation (DLT). The `triangulate_pair` function solves the overdetermined linear system $A\mathbf{X} = 0$ derived from the cross-product of pixel coordinates and projection matrices. The failure modes of this primitive emerge when the constant-velocity assumption is violently breached—such as a sudden tackle—causing the filter to lag unless $Q$ is aggressively tuned. Conversely, if $Q$ is too high, the track becomes erratic, mirroring raw detection noise. The dualities here exist between prediction (physics-based inertia) and correction (vision-based reality), mediated entirely by the dynamic covariance matrices.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive descends directly from Rudolf Kálmán’s 1960 recursive least-squares formulation, adapted for modern non-linear tracking via the Extended Kalman Filter paradigm. The specific application to skeletal tracking borrows heavily from the DeepSORT and ByteTrack architectures, which popularized the fusion of deep learning embeddings with linear Gaussian state-space models. Historically, it bridges the gap between photogrammetry’s DLT methods from the 1980s and contemporary differentiable rendering pipelines.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: In a multi-agent sporting environment, the tracker acts as an omniscient observer attempting to deduce the intent of opposing athletes. By assigning distinct process noise to different body parts, the system implicitly models the 'decision actor'—the athlete—as a constrained physical entity. The torso represents the committed center of mass (high certainty, low maneuverability), while the extremities represent exploratory probes (low certainty, high maneuverability). The tracker anticipates occlusions by trusting the inertial momentum of the torso, effectively predicting where an agent *must* be even when visually hidden.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To prevent catastrophic state collapse, strict anti-collinearity vetoes must be applied during the DLT phase. If the baseline vector between two cameras is nearly parallel to the depth vector of a keypoint, the resulting triangulation matrix becomes singular, yielding massive positional errors. Additionally, leakage vetoes monitor the determinant of the covariance matrix; if the uncertainty grows beyond a predefined geometric bound due to prolonged occlusion, the track must be severed rather than allowed to drift infinitely, preserving the integrity of the global shadow ledger.
